gloss: to some extent; even a little

definitions.gloss: to some extent; even a little; at least somewhat
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression meaning 'even if only a small amount' or 'to whatever extent possible.' Used to express that even a minimal degree of something is sufficient or relevant.

examples.japanese: {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てれば→立てる：01196_tateru⟧うれしい。
examples.english: I'd be happy if I could be of some help, even a little.

examples.japanese: {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We're looking for someone with at least some experience.

examples.japanese: {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}せれば→話す：00467_hanasu⟧、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: If you can speak even a little Japanese, traveling would probably be much more enjoyable.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧ (a little, somewhat) + なりとも (even if it be). The expression conveys a humble or modest tone — the speaker acknowledges that the amount may be small but considers it worthwhile.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧: to be of at least some help
- {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have at least some interest
- {多少|たしょう}なりとも⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have at least some influence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even a little — more casual, used in everyday speech
- ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧: somewhat — simpler form, without the nuance of 'even if only'
- いくら⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even a little bit — similar meaning, less formal

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. More common in written language and polite speech than in casual conversation.
